Chat streaming against real OpenAI API, verifies chunks received

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from liter_llm import create_client
from liter_llm._internal_bindings import ChatCompletionRequest

async def main() -> None:
    client = create_client(api_key=os.environ["OPENAI_API_KEY"])
    request = ChatCompletionRequest.from_json("{\"max_tokens\":50,\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Count from 1 to 5.\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"openai/gpt-4o-mini\"}")
    result = client.chat_stream(request)
    chunks = []
    async for chunk in result:
        chunks.append(chunk)
    print(result)

asyncio.run(main())

```
